questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Fasciola gigantica?
options: Eggs in stool during patent biliary infection; early invasive infection can be egg-negative.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Eggs in stool during patent biliary infection; early invasive infection can be egg-negative. Stool microscopy at 100–400× in the patent phase.
